flags.name: filter
flags.description: Filter logs using Railway's query syntax For deploy/build logs: Text search:   "error message", "user signup" Level filter:  @level:error, @level:warn, @level:info For HTTP logs (--http), all filterable fields: String:  @method, @path, @host, @requestId, @clientUa, @srcIp, @edgeRegion, @upstreamAddress, @upstreamProto, @downstreamProto, @responseDetails, @deploymentId, @deploymentInstanceId Numeric: @httpStatus, @totalDuration, @responseTime, @upstreamRqDuration, @txBytes, @rxBytes, @upstreamErrors For network flow logs (--network), all filterable fields: String:  @protocol, @direction, @peer, @peer_kind, @status, @drop_cause, @src, @dst, @host Numeric: @port Boolean: @dropped For DNS logs (--dns), all filterable fields: String:  @qname, @domain, @qtype, @rcode, @zone, @status Numeric operators: > >= < <= .. (range, e.g. @httpStatus:200..299) Logical operators: AND, OR, - (negation), parentheses for grouping Examples: @httpStatus:>=400 @totalDuration:>1000 -@method:OPTIONS @httpStatus:>=400 AND @path:/api (@method:GET OR @method:POST) AND @httpStatus:500 @protocol:tcp @direction:egress @peer_kind:internet @port:443

commands.description: View logs from a service.

args.name: deployment_id
args.description: Deployment ID to view logs from. Defaults to most recent successful deployment, or latest deployment if none succeeded

flags.name: deployment
flags.description: Show deployment logs

flags.name: build
flags.description: Show build logs

flags.name: http
flags.description: Show HTTP request logs

flags.name: network
flags.description: Show network flow logs

flags.name: dns
flags.description: Show DNS query logs

flags.name: filter
flags.description: Filter logs using Railway's query syntax For deploy/build logs: Text search:   "error message", "user signup" Level filter:  @level:error, @level:warn, @level:info For HTTP logs (--http), all filterable fields: String:  @method, @path, @host, @requestId, @clientUa, @srcIp, @edgeRegion, @upstreamAddress, @upstreamProto, @downstreamProto, @responseDetails, @deploymentId, @deploymentInstanceId Numeric: @httpStatus, @totalDuration, @responseTime, @upstreamRqDuration, @txBytes, @rxBytes, @upstreamErrors For network flow logs (--network), all filterable fields: String:  @protocol, @direction, @peer, @peer_kind, @status, @drop_cause, @src, @dst, @host Numeric: @port Boolean: @dropped For DNS logs (--dns), all filterable fields: String:  @qname, @domain, @qtype, @rcode, @zone, @status Numeric operators: > >= < <= .. (range, e.g. @httpStatus:200..299) Logical operators: AND, OR, - (negation), parentheses for grouping Examples: @httpStatus:>=400 @totalDuration:>1000 -@method:OPTIONS @httpStatus:>=400 AND @path:/api (@method:GET OR @method:POST) AND @httpStatus:500 @protocol:tcp @direction:egress @peer_kind:internet @port:443

flags.name: method
flags.description: Filter HTTP logs by request method (requires --http)

flags.name: status
flags.description: Filter HTTP logs by status code, network flow logs by status (ok, dropped), or DNS logs by resolution status (ok, failed)

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filter HTTP logs by request path (requires --http)

flags.name: request-id
flags.description: Filter HTTP logs by request ID (requires --http)

flags.name: protocol
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by layer 4 protocol

flags.name: direction
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by traffic direction

flags.name: peer
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by peer service name/ID or a well-known peer (internet, dns, edge-proxy)

flags.name: peer-kind
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by peer kind

flags.name: dropped
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by whether packets were dropped

flags.name: port
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by source or destination port

flags.name: src
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by source IP

flags.name: dst
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by destination IP

flags.name: host
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by source or destination IP

flags.name: drop-cause
flags.description: Filter network flow logs by drop cause

flags.name: domain
flags.description: Filter DNS logs by domain, including its subdomains

flags.name: qname
flags.description: Filter DNS logs by the exact name looked up

flags.name: qtype
flags.description: Filter DNS logs by record type (e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT)

flags.name: rcode
flags.description: Filter DNS logs by response code (e.g. NOERROR, NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL)

flags.name: zone
flags.description: Filter DNS logs by lookup zone

flags.name: latest
flags.description: Always show logs from the latest deployment, even if it failed or is still building

flags.name: since
flags.description: Show logs since a specific time (disables streaming). Accepts relative times (e.g., 30s, 5m, 2h, 1d, 1w) or ISO 8601 timestamps (e.g., 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z)

flags.name: until
flags.description: Show logs until a specific time (disables streaming). Same formats as --since
